text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Proposals for African Pavilion Sprinkler Retrofit Project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the award of Request for Proposal RFP-33 African Pavilion Sprinkler Retrofit Project to Twin Contracting in the amount of $1,449,500, subject to approval of the 2024-2033 Toronto Zoo Capital Budget and Plan including 2023 carry forward funding.
